provenance.authoringMethod: independent direct transcription plus a standalone contract-law enumerator for the two bounded constraint-observation traversal witnesses

independentObservationSearchOracle.derivation: Enumerate literal Cmaj7 degree MIDI placements, slot-major DFS states, the three applicable rejected-assignment laws, full-payload insertion/deduplication, provisional distinct-17 overflow, and the first hard-valid Open assignment directly from frozen contract arithmetic.

statePolicy.failureKind: typed refusal with evidence and no value
statePolicy.workLimitQualification: A work-limit refusal wins when the operation cannot finish the work needed to establish a later musical outcome.
statePolicy.constraintObservationOverflowQualificati: Before any legal candidate, a prospective seventeenth distinct full-payload observation is provisional: diagnostic collection stops while musical search continues. The first legal candidate clears and disables it; only a completed zero-candidate search returns the typed work-limit refusal.

checksums.recordProjectionFormat: one compact JSON array per record in stored order, followed by LF
checksums.fixturePayloadProjection: one compact JSON object with recursively sorted keys and checksums removed, followed by LF

successCases.description: A legal Auto request completes synchronously with a nonempty deterministic generated result.
Manual returns the exact stored voicing by reference and performs no generation work.
Frozen returns the exact stored voicing and generation metadata by reference with zero work.
A prospective seventeenth no-result observation cannot terminate search: the next assignment is legal and the provisional overflow is cleared.

refusalCases.description: An explicitly selected realization ID absent from the resolved chord refuses before template work.
Defensive runtime validation rejects Quartal context attached to a non-Quartal family even though the typed union excludes this request.

trigger.requestMutation: attach a nonnull well-shaped quartalContext to family balanced

refusalCases.description: Defensive runtime validation rejects a Quartal request with no context even though the typed union requires it.
Defensive runtime validation rejects a malformed Quartal context schema literal.
Defensive runtime validation rejects a malformed Quartal policy ID literal.
Defensive runtime validation rejects a malformed Quartal policy version literal.
A Quartal evidence ID outside the exact 1..256-code-point and 512-UTF-8-byte bounds is rejected.

trigger.required: 1..256 Unicode code points and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes

refusalCases.description: A typed number that violates the positive-integer Quartal evidence-version contract is rejected.
A well-shaped Quartal sequence whose member count does not match the requested effective voice count is rejected.
A Quartal sequence member absent from the explicitly selected realization is rejected at its exact index.
The first Quartal adjacency that is neither five nor six semitones is rejected at the upper degree index.
An undeclared static Shell row refuses with its exact quality-family-unavailable payload and does not substitute another family.
An undeclared Quartal row refuses with quartal-row-undeclared after valid Quartal context and does not substitute a tertian family.
All independently established constraint failures are reported in code order with deterministic within-code ordering, including otherwise-identical payloads ordered only by reason precedence.
A true attempt to accept raw candidate 97 refuses before acceptance and discards every partial candidate value.
A completed zero-candidate Cmaj7/E search with more than sixteen distinct full-payload failures returns the provisional observation overflow as a typed all-or-nothing work limit.

precedenceCases.description: Unavailable realization wins before any Quartal, family, constraint, or limit outcome can be established.
Unexpected Quartal context on a non-Quartal request wins before family and constraint lookup.
Missing required Quartal context wins before the absence of a Quartal family row is considered.
Invalid Quartal context wins before an unavailable Quartal row.
A static unavailable row wins before register search can accumulate constraint observations.
Constraints win when complete bounded search independently establishes them without attempting work beyond a cap.
The work limit wins over a suspected later constraint outcome when the required search cannot finish within a cap.

notApplicableCases.description: Cancellation belongs to resumable progression search or application orchestration, not the pure V0 call.
Stale revision rejection occurs before invocation or before application of the result.
Browser lifecycle and compatibility state cannot influence a pure theory result.
Audio availability and transport state cannot influence a pure theory result.
Storage identity, capability, and failure state cannot influence a pure theory result.
